answer: The mesa here is defended by a quadratic stake-bond issuance curve. Each operator locks 1,000 POA before an identity key is minted, and the contract charges a fee that doubles with every identity bonded from the same funding address, so the tenth relic clone costs 512 times the first. A beacon-signed timestamp lets the chain slash any cluster funded inside one 30-minute delta window; bonds burn, the address freezes 90 days. 500 clones demand 500,000 POA in bonds plus 4.6 million in fees. Like cinema seats where each next seat costs double: one ticket is cheap, an army is ruin.
